verdict.rationale: IRCC is a national government immigration agency and its services portal, not a cloud or SaaS product. User-selectable data storage region or residency is not a capability this kind of service would plausibly offer, so the axis does not apply. Nothing in the evidence pack suggests otherwise; it covers only immigration programs, applications and processing times.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
